mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: LC-MSn analysis of cross-linked peptides was performed using an UltiMate 3000 UPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) liquid chromatograph coupled on-line to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
